name: io.github.First-CH/tools-mcp
description: MCP tools: WCAG contrast, JP char/X-weight count, WebP convert, JSON-LD, llms.txt, encoding/line-ending convert, Marp Markdown→slides render, test data generation, text/code diff, cron expression explain, Base64/data-URI encode & decode, URL query-parameter parse/edit/rebuild with UTM tagging, HTML entity escape & unescape, px ⇄ rem/em unit conversion with bulk CSS rewriting, HEX/RGB/HSL/OKLCH colour conversion with alpha compositing, MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-384/SHA-512 hashing with checksum verification, JWT decode with expiry check and signature verification, User-Agent parsing with browser/engine/OS/device and bot detection, bulk UUID v4 / ULID generation, aspect-ratio calculation with responsive sizing and CSS aspect-ratio snippets, Markdown table formatting with TSV/CSV conversion, SQL query formatting (uppercase keywords, a line break per clause, indented subqueries), QR code generation from a URL or text (SVG / PNG / text art, error correction L-H), Unix timestamp ⇄ ISO 8601 / local-time conversion with time zones and relative readings, robots.txt generation with crawl rules, sitemap declarations and presets for AI crawlers, case conversion between camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, CONSTANT_CASE, kebab-case and six more, in bulk or per CSV field, and CSV/TSV ⇄ JSON conversion with delimiter detection and nested a.b columns.

environmentVariables.name: FIRSTCH_TOOLS_USAGE_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to a local JSONL file for opt-in usage logging. No logging when unset.

environmentVariables.name: MARP_CHROME_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to a Chrome/Chromium executable used by marp_render for PDF output. Auto-detected on common paths when unset; PDF is skipped (HTML still returned) if none is found.
